title: A single episode was identified as a seasonal anime单集被识别成了季度番剧
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior ### Expected Behavior 单集被识别成了季度番剧，下载的番剧本来是单集，但是sonarr识别的是整季。导致每次下载会有几百集未处理，导致需要手动导入一集，然后剩下的取消任务 Individual episodes were identified as seasonal anime, and the downloaded anime were originally individual episodes, but Sonarr identified them as entire seasons. This resulted in hundreds of episodes being unprocessed each time the download occurred, requiring manual import of one episode and then canceling the remaining tasks ### Steps To Reproduce _No response_ ### Environment ```markdown - OS: - Sonarr: - Docker Install: - Using Reverse Proxy: - Browser: - Database: ``` ### What branch are you running?
